elements.element: Preferred: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination

Preferred: return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination (not upon request)

"transition assistance for up to six (6) months" exceeds the 90-day floor
"within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client data in a standard machine-readable format"

reasons: All seven atomic preferred elements are present in one concise inserted sentence: 6-month transition assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return measured from expiration or termination, standard machine-readable format, deletion thereafter, and written certification.
The clause was wholly absent (Sections 13-14 contain no exit mechanic), so a single concise insertion after p0079 is minimal; no existing sentence was rewritten and no unrelated term was touched.

No undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced; 'Client data', 'expiration or termination' and the parties' defined names track the agreement, and the return duty is unconditional rather than request-triggered.
